The '''Codia system''' was located in the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]] of<ref name="Mid Rim" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the terrestrial,<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Moss/Legends|moss]]-covered<ref name="Monster">''[[Star Wars: What Makes a Monster?]]''</ref> [[Moon/Legends|natural satellite]] known as the [[Codian Moon/Legends|Codian Moon]].<ref name="CSWE" />

Several [[Farm/Legends|ranches]] on the Codian Moon [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]] [[Reek/Legends|reeks]]&mdash;[[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]]. Initially, the reeks were bred as [[Species/Legends|beasts]] of burden;<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">{{DB|creature|reek|reek}} and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' establish that at some point, [[Farmer/Legends|ranchers]] on the [[Codian Moon/Legends|Codian Moon]] started [[Reproduction/Legends|breeding]] and [[Merchant/Legends|selling]] [[Reek/Legends|reeks]] for use in [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] arenas. Since [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], the events of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], depicts a reek being used in the [[Petranaki arena]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in such a way, the breeding of reeks for combat purposes must have begun by that date.</ref> however, the creatures began to see use in [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] arenas,<ref name="NEGAS" /> such as<ref name="DB" /> the [[Petranaki arena]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

Shortly after the acquisition of the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Codia system was featured on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref> By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the Codian Moon remained undecided on its affiliation to either of the opposing factions of the conflict, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|139|WOR 1-2|Worlds of the Clone Wars}}</ref> The population of the Codia [[Star system/Legends|system]] numbered less than one million around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2003]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'' by [[Simon Beecroft]] was the first<ref name="Inside2">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> of a series of sources that depict the Codia system, labeled as "Codian Moon," on maps of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="FF" /><ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> In those maps, the Codian Moon was placed in the [[trailing]] direction from the world [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]].<ref name="FF" /><ref name="Inside2" /><ref name="CL" />

In contrast, the [[2006]] book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' claimed that the Codian Moon was a natural satellite of Ylesia.<ref name="NEGAS" /> That statement contradicted the prior map placement of the moon,<ref name="FF" /><ref name="Inside2" /><ref name="CL" /> with Ylesia being depicted on several maps as part of Hutt Space, on the opposite side of the galaxy.<ref name="FF" /><ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> It also created a continuity problem due to the [[1997]] novel ''[[The Paradise Snare]]'' explicitly noting that Ylesia had no moons.<ref name="Paradise">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>

The information from ''The New Essential Guide to Alien Species'' was definitively overridden by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which named the Codia system and placed it in grid square H-15, trailing from the [[Cerean system]]<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;a placement that is in agreement with the information from the pre-2006 sources.<ref name="FF" /><ref name="Inside2" /><ref name="CL" />

''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the first appearance of the Codia system.<ref name="AoI" />
